name: alert
useFor: Use default for a note (a new feature, a fact about a card), brand for an announcement that matters, destructive for a problem the person must act on. Give the bar a file-like name (voice.beta, agent.paused) or pass name={null} for a bare sheet. Lead with a lucide glyph; put one small key in AlertAction. It is shadcn's Alert API in the Banner's look.
constraints: More than one alert at a time
A filled red or blue sheet
source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the Banner (agentcard-website src/app/globals.css .v7-guide-note, .v7-guide-cta-title) and the window bar (.v7-windowbar)
title: Alert
description: A note window: the sky, blue or rose bar labeled like a file over a sheet with a glyph, a display title, a muted line and an optional key.
